offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures quality-control instruments, consumables, software and calibration services for life science, pharmaceutical, medical device and industrial customers. Products include sterilization biological indicators, data loggers, dissolution testers, bioprocessing instruments and gas flow calibrators. Sells mainly directly to regulated manufacturers and labs.

primary_products.value: biological indicators and sterilization monitoring; wireless data loggers; dissolution testing instruments; gas flow calibrators; bioprocessing quality-control instruments

primary_services.value: instrument calibration; equipment maintenance and repair; validation and testing services; software and monitoring subscriptions

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers, medical device makers, hospitals, laboratories, food and industrial companies

end_markets.value: pharmaceutical; biotechnology; medical devices; healthcare; food and beverage; industrial

revenue_model.value: product sales: instruments and consumables such as biological indicators; service fees: calibration, repair and validation services; subscription: cloud-based monitoring software and data services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds instruments and consumables from purchased components, sold to regulated manufacturers and labs; service provider: calibration and testing services for customer equipment

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: sterilization, cold chain monitoring, biopharma instruments and calibration, sharing quality-control customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams to pharma, hospital and lab customers; distributors / dealers: third-party distributors for international markets; online: web ordering of consumables and instruments

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: products used in FDA-regulated sterilization and pharma quality processes, ISO standards and FDA quality rules apply
